problems.reason: Both sentences state the same parent group (Citipatinae) for Huanansaurus.
Sentence 8 discusses the genus Corythoraptor, which is a different taxon, not Huanansaurus itself.
The text states the animal belongs to subfamily Oviraptorinae and is a sister genus to Citipati, yet the Paleobiology Database lists its parent group as Citipatinae, a different subfamily.
Sentences 16 and 18 give conflicting subfamily assignments for Huanansaurus: 16 places it in Oviraptorinae, while 18 lists Citipatinae as its parent group.
